# SuperFix Mechanical

> Family-owned appliance repair and installation company in Ottawa, Ontario.
> Residential service for homes, condos and rental properties, with same-day
> diagnostics available subject to availability.

SuperFix Mechanical repairs and installs home appliances. Repairs are diagnosed
by a certified appliance technician with five years of experience, and a clear
quote is given before any repair work begins. Repairs carry a 30-day warranty
on parts and labour. The company is insured.

Hours: every day, 8 am to 8 pm, including weekends.

Pricing: the diagnostic fee is $89 plus tax (CAD). Repair and installation
prices are quoted after diagnosis, before any work begins.

We do not offer commercial service or HVAC (heating and air conditioning).
